channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Forests vs flats? Singapore’s land development debate needs to move beyond that
item.description: Amid concerns about clearing Maju Forest for housing, suggestions that Singapore should only build on “brownfield sites” are reasonable. But they may also overlook a few things, says Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy’s Woo Jun Jie. Forests vs flats? Singapore’s land development debate needs to move beyond that.

item.title: Four killed, two injured in central China apartment building fire
item.description: Firefighters rescued the six people from the high-rise residential building and sent them to the hospital for treatment. Four of them later died despite medical efforts, while the remaining two are still receiving medical treatment, says sources Four killed, two injured in central China apartment building fire.

item.title: Chaos of border crossing gives way to limbo for Moroccans on Ceuta’s streets
item.description: People among the more than 50,000 who entered Spanish enclave this week describe the journey and their prospectsFour days ago, Youssef El Abbas saw an opportunity to reclaim the life he had lost seven years earlier. News was circulating that about 400 people had swum from Morocco to the neighbouring Spanish enclave of Ceuta on the north African coast, approximately 12 miles (19km) across the strai.

item.title: Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi
item.description: Sofia* was 27, raising her seven-year-old son alone in Venezuela, and running out of options. For years she had distributed personal hygiene products door to door, but as her customers’ finances collapsed, so did her income. Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi.

item.title: At Least 3 Killed, 21 Wounded In Moscow Restaurant Bombing, Russian Authorities Say
item.description: Russian authorities said on August 2 that an improvised explosive device was detonated at a restaurant in central Moscow, killing three people and wounding 21 others, as investigators worked to determine who was behind the bombing. 3 Killed, 21 Wounded In Moscow Restaurant Bombing, Russian Authorities Say.

item.title: For These Ukrainian Soldiers, Accepting Death Proved The Key To Living
item.description: When Serhiy Kutrakov decided to take up arms in 2014 to defend Ukraine from Russian-backed separatists, he accepted he would likely be killed in combat. Documentarian Yulia Hontaruk followed Kutrakov and two other soldiers on and off the battlefield for 12 years. For These Ukrainian Soldiers, Accepting Death Proved The Key To Living.

item.title: Trump Says He Called Off Impending Attack On Iran, Insists Deal Is Close
item.description: Trump said he has decided to hold off on new attacks on Iran, claiming the perimeters of a deal have been agreed with Tehran and that Israel is joining the US President Donald Trump said he has decided to "hold off" on any new attacks on Iran, saying "the perimeters" of a deal have been agreed to with Tehran and adding that Israel was joining him in the commitment.

item.title: Anti-LGBTQ+ laws are on the rise across west Africa, campaigners warn
item.description: Activists in the region say politicians regard LGBTQ+ people as ‘the easiest scapegoats to maintain their power’A growing number of west African countries are implementing or strengthening anti-LGBTQ+ laws, amid local political pressures and a global pushback against LGBTQ+ rights. In March, Senegal doubled the maximum prison sentence for gay sex to 10 years and criminalised the “promotion” of homo Anti-LGBTQ+ laws are on the rise across west Africa, campaigners warn.

item.title: Tourist plane crashes during flight over Peru’s Nazca Lines, killing 13
item.description: Aircraft crashes into field after departing from the nearby city of Ica, according to local authoritiesAt least 13 people have died after a plane carrying tourists crashed into a field in Peru, local authorities said. Aircraft crashes into field after departing from the nearby city of Pisco, according to local authorities At least 13 people, among them foreign tourists, have been killed in a plane crash in southern Peru, near the Nazca Lines, police reported on Saturday. Local authorities in Nazca confirmed that 11 tourists and two pilots died when the Cessna Grand Caravan crashed in Pueblo Viejo, approximately.

item.title: Zelenskyy Says 'Answers' Needed On Patriot Delivery As Civilian Death Toll Climbs
item.description: In the wake of the latest deadly Russian air strikes on Kyiv and other cities, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed frustration with his Western allies, urging speedier delivery of urgently needed Patriot air defense missiles and other weapons. Zelenskyy Expresses Frustration With Pace Of Patriot Deliveries As Civilian Death Toll Climbs. Zelenskyy Says 'Answers' Needed On Patriot Delivery As Civilian Death Toll Climbs.

item.title: Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile Attack On Kyiv
item.description: Russia launched dozens of ballistic missiles at Kyiv, killing at least nine people and injuring 23, according to emergency services. Zelenskyy said a shortage of air defense missiles limited Ukraine's ability to intercept the attack. Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile Attack On Kyiv.

item.title: Biggest Clue In US-Iran Conflict Is 'The Dog That Hasn't Barked,' Says War College's Jacob Stoil
item.description: A renewed exchange of military strikes and threats between the US and Iran has raised fresh fears of a wider Middle East war. But Jacob Stoil, research professor of Middle East security studies at the US Army War College, argues the more important story may be what has not happened. Biggest Clue In US-Iran Conflict Is 'The Dog That Hasn't Barked,' Says War College's Jacob Stoil.

item.title: 10-Year-Old Ukrainian Gymnast Wins Gold After Losing Leg In Russian Strike
item.description: In 2022, Oleksandra Paskal lost her leg following a Russian missile strike on Ukraine’s Odesa region. She was just six years old. Following months of intense rehabilitation, she learned to walk with a prosthesis -- and made a remarkable return to rhythmic gymnastics. 10-Year-Old Ukrainian Gymnast Wins Gold After Losing Leg In Russian Strike.

item.title: Patriot Debate Deepens As Don Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms
item.description: US President Donald Trump's decision to step back from his earlier pledge to allow Ukraine to manufacture Patriot missile interceptors has prompted renewed debate in Washington over the future direction of US military support for Kyiv. Patriot Debate Deepens As Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms. Patriot Debate Deepens As Don Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms.

item.title: Russia Pounds Kyiv With Ballistic Missiles As Ukraine Struggles With Air Defense Shortages
item.description: Russia targeted the Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles early on August 1 as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pressed for the Washington to grant licenses for Kyiv to produce its own Patriot air defense missiles amid apparent renewed reluctance by US President Donald Trump. Russia Pounds Kyiv With Ballistic Missiles As Ukraine Struggles With Air Defense Shortages.

item.title: FTSE 100 on track for best month since first US attacks on Iran five months ago – as it happened
item.description: Live, rolling coverage as the AA and RAC report prices rising to around £1.60 per litre after Donald Trump ordered renewed bombing in the Middle EastThe story piquing the interest of the financial press this morning is that of Leopold Aschenbrenner, the AI Wunderkind (he’s German-born) who has been forced to sell off his fund in a fire sale after the AI boom ran out of steam.

item.title: Strong El Niño ahead, UN weather agency warns
item.description: As much of the world faces grapples with above normal temperatures and major rainfall changes, the UN Meteorological Organization (WMO) warned on Friday that El Niño, a powerful climate pattern shaping global weather, will intensify starting next month. Strong El Niño ahead, UN weather agency warns.

item.title: Archbishop of Canterbury vows to support £100m pledge helping communities affected by enslavement
item.description: During her first visit to Ghana, Dame Sarah Mullally expressed regret and said the controversial fund symbolises the Christian belief in repentanceAt a former British castle where thousands of enslaved Africans were held before being shipped across the Atlantic, the archbishop of Canterbury expressed “lament” for the Church of England’s involvement in transatlantic chattel slavery and reaffirmed h Archbishop of Canterbury vows to support £100m pledge helping communities affected by enslavement.

In April 2025 India and Pakistan, two nuclear-armed countries that share a tense border, came dangerously close to a major confrontation after militants attacked Indian tourists near the popular resort town of Pahalgam in Indian Kashmir.
